name: o90425

schema.title: Ansible Inventory
schema.description: Ansible Inventory for the script inventory plugin

hosts.description: list of hosts that are part of this group

vars.description: Variables to assign to hosts that are part of this group

^\\w$.description: Vars for this hosts in this group

children.description: list of groups that are children of this group, their hosts will be added to this group

_meta.description: Key that avoids calling the script per host

hostvars.description: Each key is a hostname and the value is a dictionary of the variables for that host

description:
The current Ansible inventory defines two primary groups. Group **a** comprises the hosts **x** and **y** and carries a group‑level variable under the key `p` where `example` is set to `"value"`. Additionally, group a lists **b** as a child group, meaning that the hosts of **b** are implicitly part of **a** as well. Group **b** itself contains a single host, **z**, and does not declare any variables or further children.

Host‑specific details are recorded under the meta section. Host **x** is associated with two sets of variables: within group a it uses `ansible_user` set to `admin`, while under group b it specifies `ansible_port` as `22`. Host **y** inherits only the group a variable `ansible_user`, which is set to `root`. Finally, host **z** is linked to a group‑specific entry for group c, where its `ansible_user` is defined as `ubuntu`.
